name: Visa B-1/B-2 (Tourism / Business)

phases.name: Document Collection
documents_pt: Declaração de imposto de renda (último ano)
documents_es: Estados de cuenta bancarios del patrocinador (si aplica)
steps: Employment verification letter, job position & salary, length of employment
Gather proof of ties to home country (employment, property/lease, family, business, financial commitments)
Define travel purpose, planned dates, cities to visit, accommodation, estimated duration
Explain intent to return (return ticket, explanation of stay extension, ties to home country)
Review travel history in the U.S. (cities, activities, no unauthorized work, other countries visited)
Draft invitation letter / employer letter / sponsor letter / address letter as needed

phases.name: Case Preparation
steps: Confirm consistent travel plan (cities, states, dates)
Explain financial capability and proof of financial support
Clearly structure ties to home country
Confirm profile consistent with B-2 intent and no immigrant intent
Check for no red flags (overstay, violations)
Practice interview questions with short, clear answers

pricing.notes: No Plus tier for this service.
pricing.source: Real Saes Professional Services contract (Downloads/Contratos), extracted 2026-08-02.

standard_includes: DS-160 preparation based on 18 years of experience
Google Drive link for document uploads
